current_flow: reconciliation-proof is the FINAL sap-ingestion task and a PROOF task: no new endpoint, grant, migration, warehouse schema, or dependency. It adds a read-only reconciliation.repository.ts (reconcileActualsByKeyMonth returns rawNet=SUM(debit-credit) over the active actuals batch's raw rows, goldNet=SUM(actual_net) over the actual_by_key_month view, and lineCount, all paise-exact numeric(18,2) strings), a frozen in-repo fixture (DUB, 2026-07-01, 88, 11512712.07), a hermetic unit test of the query+fixture logic, and a WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 gated leaf that truncates the disposable dev warehouse, ingests the REAL July SAP Report workbook via the shipped IngestService.ingestActuals path, and asserts rawNet===goldNet===11512712.07 with lineCount 88, whole-upload row-count + (txn_no,line_id) integrity, and idempotent replace (new active batch, prior retained, gold total unchanged). Actuals-only; mis_budget never touched (0004).
new_abstractions: reconcileActualsByKeyMonth - a read-only two-way (raw rows + gold view) plant+period net reconciliation query
the frozen july-dub-reconciliation.json expectation fixture + its paise-string loader
a WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 gated leaf that grounds the real July DUB net and proves idempotent replace

criteria_map.a demonstrated warehouse-DB test grounds: KEEP (proof hardened). The July DUB net is grounded to EXACTLY Rs 11,512,712.07 (paise) across BOTH the active raw sap_transaction rows and the actual_by_key_month gold view, against a frozen in-repo fixture; the cold read independently CONFIRMED the parser-canonical DUB is 88 rows totalling exactly 11512712.07. The proof logic is covered hermetically (reconcile query + fixture loader, decision 0009 real-named leaves) and the exact figure is the demonstrated D-0008 gated leaf; isolation is deterministic (truncate the disposable dev DB) and whole-upload integrity (4,113-row count + (txn_no,line_id) uniqueness) is asserted, not just the DUB subset (findings 1,2,3,4).
criteria_map.re-uploading the July DUB actuals replac: KEEP (proof hardened). Re-uploading the same July file replaces the (actuals, 2026-07) month with exactly one new active batch, the prior batch retained, no duplicate active rows, whole-upload integrity preserved, and the gold total unchanged; the idempotency read-invariant (only the active batch counts) is also proven hermetically (findings 1,3).

gaps: The required-test contract could gate green without demonstrating the reconciliation: both required_tests were hermetic, neither named the WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 leaf, verify runs only test:hermetic where that leaf skips, and t-rp-c2 had no required leaf at all

'Starts at a migrated empty warehouse' was false: migrateWarehouse() only applies migrations and the docker warehouse-data volume persists, so a re-run would overwrite whatever July batch was active - no isolation/clean-slate strategy was defined

The idempotency assertion reconciled only the 88 canonical-DUB rows while the upload is all 4,113 July rows, so a duplicate or omission OUTSIDE DUB could pass both the DUB total and the DUB line-count checks

The plan did not reconcile against the in-force D-0008 warehouse:proof: warehouse:proof still runs the synthetic 2099 seed proof while this task proposes a gated test - which executable is the authoritative demonstrated proof was ambiguous

The approved STORY plan names Sheet1 'New SAP' as the actuals source while the shipped parser (and this task) correctly use the 'SAP Report' sheet header row 3 - the story plan contradicts the implementation handover
Decision reconciliation was inaccurate: cited decision 0018 does not exist (the only D-0018 is an observability deferral) and 0002 is the Phase-1 Financial MIS decision, not 'one worktree/story'
backend/src/warehouse/reconciliation.ts violated the constitution's required role suffix for a new TypeScript file that does database I/O (pnp-coding-standards-modular-monolith)
resolutions: Split the hermetic required_tests to cover BOTH criteria's logic (reconcile query rawNet==goldNet for t-rp-c1; active-only isolation - inactive prior batch and budget batch excluded - as the t-rp-c2 read-invariant; fixture loader integrity), and kept the exact-figure DB assertion as the demonstrated D-0008 gated leaf (decision 0009 + D-0008: gated real-DB proof is committed reviewer-visible host evidence, not a verify.py-enforced test). The pinned gated command carries the mandatory TS_NODE_PROJECT+TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY prefix (0009 false-green guard).

Specified deterministic isolation: the gated leaf TRUNCATEs ingest_batch+sap_transaction (CASCADE) to a clean slate at the start (migrate does not clear rows) and asserts only on the batches it creates; warehouse-db (127.0.0.1:5433) is the disposable local dev DB used only for these host proofs.

Added whole-upload integrity assertions to both criteria: the active (actuals,2026-07) batch's TOTAL sap_transaction row count equals the parsed row count (all 4,113) and (txn_no, line_id) is unique across the entire active batch - a defect outside DUB can no longer hide behind the DUB total/line-count.

Clarified in the contract and plan that this gated reconciliation.repository.test.ts leaf IS the authoritative demonstrated July-DUB reconciliation evidence (tests.json + committed), DISTINCT from and not replacing warehouse:proof (which stays warehouse-schema's synthetic structural seed proof); this task does NOT edit warehouse-migrate.ts or warehouse:proof.

Confirmed by repo inspection that 'SAP Report' (header row 3) is the settled source - the shipped/merged parser's required header set matches only that sheet. The task plan already uses 'SAP Report'; the stale story-plan prose is ledgered as a lesson (plans/lessons/...SAP-Report-sheet...) so downstream stories inherit the correct sheet; no change to this task.

Corrected the decision citations against ./forge decision list --active: 0004 (no pre-join, actuals-only), 0009 (required-tests real name + TS_NODE_PROJECT), 0014 (the Rs 11,512,712.07 target), 0015 (warehouse snake_case); removed the nonexistent 0018 and the mis-cited 0002.

Renamed the module to backend/src/warehouse/reconciliation.repository.ts (and its test to reconciliation.repository.test.ts) - the role suffix the constitution requires for a DB-I/O module; write_scope, required_tests, reviewer_focus and the plan updated to match.
